name: Baby Bonfire
summary: A line of small home objects that bring fire, water, air, earth, light and weather indoors without a screen.
boundary: Nothing has been manufactured, burn-tested, certified or offered for sale. Every piece named is a design direction.

operating_model.question: How far can AI resources take a physical product toward market?

system.piece: Any object in the line. Works with nothing plugged in.
system.place: A standard palm-size stone tile that every piece sits on. Carries a tap chip.
system.puck: A swappable disc under the place that senses heat and light, and later air. No cameras or microphones.
system.scene: The arrangement of pieces on places.
system.fire_is_the_switch: A sensed flame is a condition met and the room responds: an air column draws, a lamp drops, a sound starts. Snuffing reverses it.
system.open_footprint: The place footprint is meant to be published so other makers can build pieces. Stage five; no date.

items: Baby Bonfire hearth (palm-size lidded ceramic pedestal, breath opening, fuel shaped like tiny pallets)
Chimney (capture column with a clear-room light)
Paired hearths (light one, the other glows in another home)

stages.name: Exploration
stages.gate: One object chosen as the wedge.

stages.name: Works-like prototype
stages.work: Heat, tip-over and ash-containment testing against the fire-safety bar for candle accessories.

stages.name: First small local run
stages.work: A short run made within about 25 miles of El Segundo.

stages.name: Publish the place
stages.work: Release the place footprint so other makers can build pieces.

rules: palo santo only as Bursera graveolens, naturally fallen and documented
white sage only farmed with proof, or not used
no team names or marks without a license
